previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson was admitted for acute decompensated heart failure with progressive lower extremity edema and orthopnea. He was started on IV furosemide and metolazone, leading to significant diuresis and a 20-pound fluid loss. His kidney function remained stable, and he responded well to therapy. A transfusion was given for asymptomatic anemia without active bleeding. His warfarin was continued at a reduced target INR due to mechanical aortic valve and high bleeding risk. Diabetes was managed with sliding scale insulin. He was discharged home with home health services, on increased torsemide 60 mg daily, with close follow-up for heart failure and anticoagulation management.
